title: SEO, GEO & AEO Content Developer
description:
**Brand, SEO & Content Developer**

**Location:**
Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India

**Work Arrangement:**
On-site

**Contract:**
Full-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our international work requires a strong digital presence, clear communication and consistent brand positioning across multiple markets.

We are looking for a
**Brand, SEO & Content Developer**
to support the growth of the GCRS brand through content, search visibility, digital campaigns and website development.

**The Role**

This is a digital marketing and content role combining
**brand development, SEO, content creation and digital execution**
.

You will be responsible for developing high-quality content, improving organic search visibility, supporting website growth and ensuring that GCRS communicates its expertise consistently across digital channels.

You will work closely with business development, regulatory experts, technology and leadership teams to understand subject matter and convert complex information into clear and engaging content.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute content strategies
* Create website pages, blogs, articles and thought-leadership content
* Conduct keyword research and SEO planning
* Optimize existing website content
* Develop on-page and basic technical SEO strategies
* Monitor organic search performance
* Knowledge of SEO, AEO and GEO
* Use of Generative engine optimization like ChatGPT etc.
* Conduct competitor and market research
* Develop content calendars
* Support LinkedIn and other digital communication
* Maintain consistent brand messaging
* Develop marketing campaigns and landing-page content
* Work with website developers to implement content
* Improve website structure and internal linking
* Monitor website analytics and SEO performance
* Prepare content-performance reports
* Identify opportunities for organic traffic growth
* Coordinate with subject-matter experts for technical content
* Edit and proofread content
* Support newsletters and email campaigns
* Develop case studies, service pages and corporate content
* Ensure content is accurate, professional and aligned with GCRS positioning
* Support international and market-specific content requirements

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who combines strong writing ability with an understanding of SEO, digital marketing and brand development.

You should be able to take a complex subject and turn it into clear, useful and engaging content.

You should also be commercially aware and understand that content needs to support visibility, credibility, lead generation and business growth.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in content marketing, SEO, digital marketing, brand or a related role
* Strong written English
* Excellent research and editing skills
* Understanding of SEO principles
* Experience with keyword research
* Understanding of on-page SEO
* Experience creating website content
* Understanding of content strategy
* Knowledge of Google Analytics and Search Console
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to understand complex subject matter
* Strong communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple content projects
* Understanding of brand consistency

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience in B2B marketing and business-to-business lead generation.
* A professional background in consultancy or professional services.
* Exposure to international markets and global marketing activities.
* Knowledge of cosmetics, beauty, personal care, wellness or other regulated industries.
* Familiarity with WordPress or other content management systems (CMS).
* Working knowledge of SEMrush, Ahrefs or similar SEO tools.
* Experience developing and managing LinkedIn marketing campaigns.
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS for digital content and website updates.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted content creation and marketing tools.
* Experience developing thought leadership content, including industry articles, insights and professional publications.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Established a structured content calendar
* Improved the consistency of GCRS brand communication
* Identified and targeted valuable SEO opportunities
* Improved website content and organic visibility
* Developed high-quality thought-leadership content
* Established regular content-performance reporting
* Supported lead-generation and digital marketing objectives
* Built stronger coordination between subject-matter experts and marketing

**Why Join Us?**

You will have the opportunity to work with an international brand operating across multiple markets and in specialist regulatory sectors.

**Important:**
This is a
**fully on-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**
. Candidates must be willing to
**work from the Hapur office five days a week**
.

To apply, please submit your CV through LinkedIn with a short covering note explaining your relevant experience and, where possible, examples of your previous content or SEO work.

title: Marketing Data & Application Engineer
description:

title: Social Media Strategist
company: Rank Top 3 on Amazon | Harpy Media
description:
Are you a Content Creator who has built an audience on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, or Twitter/X? We’re looking for people who understand the science and strategy behind audience growth.

We need a
**Social Media Strategist**
with at least one year of hands-on experience in Content Strategy, Social Media Growth, and organic Content Distribution, either for a personal brand or a business.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop content calendars and Content Marketing strategies for one or more social media platforms.
* Identify what to post, who it serves, and why it deserves attention.
* Analyse content performance, Organic Reach, audience behaviour, and what makes content work.
* Build repeatable strategies for Organic Social Media growth and Personal Branding.

**Who should apply?**

**Whether you’re a LinkedIn Creator, Instagram Creator, YouTube Creator, or Twitter/X Creator, we care more about what you’ve built than your professional job title. Professional work experience isn’t mandatory, but one year of demonstrated content-building and growth experience is.**

**We need strategic thinkers; execution can be handled by someone else.**

* **How to apply:**
  DM your CV and a link to the account you’ve helped grow. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an assessment or video interview.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**MARKETING MANAGER – PIPES, FITTINGS, SPOOLS \& SKIDS** 




**Company** 




 Kisaan Techno Forge Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location** 




 Sikandrabad, Uttar Pradesh
 



**Department** 




 Marketing \& Business Development
 



**Reports to** 




 Director / Managing Director
 



**Employment** 




 Full\-time
 



**Experience** 




 5\+ years relevant experience
 



**Business Scope** 




 Domestic \& Export
 



**Products** 




 Pipes • Fittings • Spools • Skids
 


 1\. POSITION PURPOSE
 
 Lead business development and sales for pipes, fittings, fabricated piping spools and skids; build a strong customer/project pipeline; secure profitable orders; and ensure disciplined coordination from enquiry through payment collection and customer satisfaction.
 


 2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
**•** 
 Develop and execute annual/quarterly sales and business\-development plans for domestic and export markets.
 



**•** 
 Identify and develop EPCs, OEMs, consultants, project owners, industrial customers, institutional buyers and approved\-vendor opportunities.
 



**•** 
 Generate enquiries through customer visits, references, tenders, exhibitions, industry networks and digital channels; maintain a live CRM/sales pipeline.
 



**•** 
 Understand drawings, specifications, scope of supply, materials, applicable codes/standards, inspection requirements and delivery expectations.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate techno\-commercial quotations, costing, margins, payment terms, delivery schedules, clarifications, negotiations and order finalisation.
 



**•** 
 Drive enquiry\-to\-order conversion, order booking, revenue, contribution margin and collections; protect commercial discipline.
 



**•** 
 Track projects and market intelligence: demand, pricing, competitors, upcoming projects and customer/vendor\-registration requirements.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate with Engineering, Estimation, Production, Planning, Purchase, Quality, Dispatch and Finance to ensure realistic commitments and timely execution.
 



**•** 
 Support contract review, pre\-order meetings, customer documentation, complaint resolution and recovery of overdue payments.
 



**•** 
 Develop repeat business and strategic/key\-account relationships; represent the company at customer meetings, exhibitions, conferences and vendor meets.
 



**•** 
 Lead/mentor the marketing team, set measurable targets, review performance and ensure systematic enquiry, quotation, order and customer\-feedback tracking.
 


 3\. TARGET MARKETS / CUSTOMER SEGMENTS
 
 Oil \& Gas • Petrochemicals • Chemicals • Power • Water Treatment • Pharmaceuticals • Infrastructure • Process Equipment • EPC Projects • Engineering \& Manufacturing • OEMs and Industrial Buyers.
 


 4\. KEY DELIVERABLES / KPIs
 
**•** 
 Sales \& order booking versus target; revenue and contribution margin.
 



**•** 
 Qualified pipeline value/coverage, enquiry\-to\-order conversion and quotation turnaround.
 



**•** 
 New customers/accounts, repeat orders and customer retention.
 



**•** 
 Domestic/export business growth and project/customer penetration.
 



**•** 
 On\-time commercial follow\-up, order execution coordination and collection/DSO performance.
 



**•** 
 Customer satisfaction, complaint closure and accuracy/timeliness of management reporting.
 


 5\. QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE
 
**•** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing or related discipline; B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical/Production/Industrial) preferred.
 



**•** 
 MBA in Marketing/Business Development is desirable.
 



**•** 
 Minimum 5 years’ relevant B2B industrial marketing/sales/business\-development experience; experience in pipes, fittings, piping fabrication, spools, skids, process equipment or engineering products preferred.
 



**•** 
 Exposure to EPC/OEM/consultant/project procurement, vendor registration, pre\-qualification and tendering is desirable.
 



**•** 
 Established industry/customer network and experience with major engineering organisations are an advantage.
 


 6\. TECHNICAL / COMMERCIAL KNOWLEDGE
 
**•** 
 Working knowledge of piping products, fabrication, welding, machining, inspection/testing, drawings, BOM and scope of supply.
 



**•** 
 Understanding of materials, applicable national/international codes, QAP/ITP and customer documentation.
 



**•** 
 Ability to assess costing, margins, commercial terms, delivery, technical/commercial risks and contract requirements.
 



**•** 
 Awareness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 systems and disciplined documentation.
 


 7\. CORE COMPETENCIES
 
**•** 
 Business development, consultative selling, negotiation and closing.
 



**•** 
 Strong communication, presentation, networking and relationship management in English and Hindi.
 



**•** 
 Commercial acumen, market intelligence, forecasting, data analysis and CRM discipline.
 



**•** 
 Cross\-functional coordination, problem solving, ownership and team leadership.
 



**•** 
 High integrity, confidentiality, professional maturity and customer focus.
 



**•** 
 Result orientation with SMART commitments and strong follow\-up discipline; willing to travel extensively as required.
 


 8\. MANAGEMENT REPORTING
 
 Provide periodic MIS covering enquiry funnel, quotations, order booking, pipeline, sales forecast, customer visits, market intelligence, order status, collections, risks and corrective actions.
 


 9\. APPLICATION INFORMATION
 
 Candidates should submit an updated résumé with current/expected compensation, notice period, relevant industry experience, key customers/markets handled, major business achievements and willingness to travel.
